summary: The MySupervisors feature manages the profiles and roles of staff members within HSPnet, including editing and viewing permissions based on user roles such as System Administrator, Local Administrator, Content Manager, and others.
purpose: To facilitate management of supervisor profiles by allowing authorized users to edit, view, and organize staff information while respecting role-based access controls.

workflows.name: Profile Management
steps: Check user session for editing rights
Load profile information based on user access

business_rules: Local Administrator can edit within permitted departments
Content Manager can manage role-specific content
Placement Coordinators, Instructors, Course Leaders have view-only access
validations: Email is required for HSPnet users
Phone number must adhere to formatting rules
conditions: User must not be a view-only user to edit profiles
Access flags determine visibility of certain fields
system_behavior: Profiles are highlighted based on session state
Screen access is editable based on user role
Grid and form view modes are handled based on user actions
exceptions: Inactive staff profiles restrict certain actions
